links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT mandible fracture patient answers versus recommended patient education levels
links.effect: Readability was above recommended levels for patient education materials for both ChatGPT 3.5 and 4o, with no significant difference between versions. Accuracy was also low.
links.quote: Readability was above recommended levels for patient education materials.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and accuracy of ChatGPT responses to patient questions about mandibular fractures without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
